basic_info.description: Studio condo overlooking the outdoor pool from its private balcony. Spacious combo living/dining room with direct access to a private balcony. Generous office nook. Kitchen with stone countertops, dishwasher, disposal, electric range, refrigerator, and breakfast bar. Sizable bath with shower over tub. Guest and walk-in closets provide added storage. The bedroom alcove with a verdant outlook. HOA fees include a 24/7 lobby attendant, water, trash, heat, basic cable & Internet, 1-car assigned parking in the gated garage, an outdoor pool, and a shared laundry room. Conveniently located near restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and coffee shops. Easy access to public transportation. Note the main building address is 900 Bush Street.
